item.title: Attorney General Pam Bondi says 30 more people who protested at Minnesota church have been charged
item.description: Attorney General Pam Bondi says federal prosecutors have indicted 30 more people tied to a protest at a Minnesota church over an immigration enforcement crackdown.

item.title: The Danny Moses Show: Could there be another Big Short?
item.description: Danny Moses answers questions he gets asked a lot: Is there another Big Short? Are we seeing the same warning signs today? And what really happened behind the scenes during the financial crisis?

item.title: Stranded travelers scramble to make new connections as war shuts much of Middle East to air travel
item.description: Stranded travelers are scrambling to make new connections and get through to airlines after the attack on Iran by the United States and Israel shut down much of the Middle East to air travel.

item.title: Airlines are cracking down on carry-ons: Here's how to avoid a gate-check
item.description: More and more airlines are forcing passengers to tag and gate-check their bag, just as they are about to board. Why flying regional jets with a roller bag now makes you prime for a gate-check.

item.title: Government says Live Nation bullied venues, artists in ticketing market
item.description: DOJ and 30 states take Live Nation to trial, accusing the Ticketmaster parent of monopolizing the ticketing market and harming fans.

item.title: Anxious travelers scramble as Iran war strands tens of thousands across the Middle East
item.description: Tens of thousands of people are stranded across the Middle East as the Iran war spreads throughout the region.

item.title: Trader Joe's issues frozen food recall over glass contamination concerns
item.description: Trader Joe's is recalling several frozen food varieties that may contain glass, urging customers to return products to any store for a full refund.

item.title: Retirement savings grow, yet more workers take hardship withdrawals
item.description: Vanguard reports 401(k) hardship withdrawals rose to 6% in 2025 as access eased, while average balances grew 13% to nearly $168,000.

item.title: US stocks sink after oil spikes to its highest price since the summer of 2024
item.description: Stocks sank on Wall Street Thursday after the price of oil spiked to its highest level since the summer of 2024 because of the war with Iran.

item.title: Lawmakers push to ban government officials from prediction markets after bets on Iran strike, Khamenei's death
item.description: Senators are calling for new legislation after millions of dollars in bets were placed on prediction market sites tied to U.S. air strikes on Iran and the death of the country's supreme leader.
